resources.string: In OsmAnd open Menu → Plugins and tap “OsmAnd Companion” to enable it.
Make sure OsmAnd or OsmAnd+ is installed, then tap Connect.
OsmAnd is not installed. Install OsmAnd or OsmAnd+ first.
Opens Companion\'s features whenever OsmAnd opens, even if Companion was closed.
A minute after you leave OsmAnd, Companion stops and its notification goes away. Needs Start with OsmAnd, which starts it again.

Android only tells an app that another one opened through an accessibility service. Companion\'s only sees which app is in front, never what\'s on the screen.\n\nOn the next screen, open “OsmAnd Companion: start with OsmAnd” and turn it on.
If Android says the setting is restricted, open Settings → Apps → OsmAnd Companion, tap ⋮ → Allow restricted settings, and try again.
To stop starting with OsmAnd, turn off “OsmAnd Companion: start with OsmAnd” on the next screen.
Share crash reports and usage stats
Crash reports and counts of which features get used go to Sentry. Never your location, stops, searches or anything else about you.

Companion can send crash reports and anonymous counts of which features get used to Sentry, so I can fix what breaks and know what\'s worth working on.\n\nNever your location, the stops you look at, your searches, or anything else about you. You can turn it off any time in Settings.
Also offers test versions of what\'s coming next, before it\'s ready for everyone. They may have bugs. Turned off, you get the next regular version once it\'s out.
Allow OsmAnd Companion to install apps, then go back to finish the update.
